description: Implementation of SbCPUFeaturesGet() for various CPU architectures (ARM, ARM64, x86, x86_64) on Linux platform, including parsing /proc/cpuinfo, using getauxval(), and executing CPUID instructions to detect CPU features.

classes.name: ProcCpuInfo
classes.description: Class that reads and parses /proc/cpuinfo to extract CPU feature strings and integers.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet
methods.description: Main function that detects CPU features based on architecture, calling architecture-specific functions.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet_ARM
methods.description: Detects CPU features on ARM/ARM64 architectures by parsing /proc/cpuinfo and using getauxval() or HWCap flags.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet_X86
methods.description: Detects CPU features on x86/x86_64 architectures using CPUID instruction and parsing /proc/cpuinfo.
